reviews.text: Yesterday was our first experience with taking our 18 month old dog to a daycare.  The caring Jet Pet team took the time to do a full assessment and report on how he adapted.  Not only was the assessment free they also welcomed him back to a free additional session, to ensure he gets comfortable, even though he passed.  So happy to find a great place to send our fur baby when in Vancouver.
Always feels good receiving pictures of my baby while away on vacation. To see him happy and taken care of is the best feeling in the world. Thank you Jet Pet Resort for your stellar service.

I had a great in depth tour of the kennel plus my fur baby had a 2h first visit interview ... the Staff especially the Manager was very friendly, caring & understanding of his recent sudden health decline.
They are willingly to provide extra care & love during his upcoming boarding, thank you very much 😊 it definitely brightened mine & my fur baby day.
I contacted many kennels all refused to take care of him due to his health condition but Jet Pet is the only one willingly to give him a chance in assessing him, thank you thank you for your kindness & professionism.
A 2 thumbs up from me 😀

First time using Boarding service. Though my 2 small breed puppies goto daycare from time to time to get used to the team and other dogs. My puppies were very happy to see me on pickup. During the stay I got notifications of their pictures During their stay without prompting. Just like daycare.  They ate the food I provided. JetPet provided rice.
We will definitely be coming back for Boarding and daycare.  Highly recommend.

We came to JetPet Olympic Village for daycare and boarding many years.
The staff know my dog well and truly care. They pay attention to behavior, communicate clearly with parents (and my dog as well), and are very responsible. I never worry about my dog, even when I’m on vacation.

Jet Pet always takes such good care of my two pups!  My big girl is a shy soul in a burly build and my little rascal terrier is all bombast.  And they are both perfectly tired when I pick them up!  Whether half day or full day.

Thanks, Jet Pet… for being their home away from home. 🐾🐾♥️🐾🐾

They are so experience in handling dogs. I am so happy. They let my dog feels like she was a part of their family. Thank you so so much team. Akira will see u again.  If there is 10 stars I can give I will give to them. Thank you Jet pet team.

We have been taking our puppy Bruno to Jetpet Olympic village since he was 4 months old every time we travel. Bruno absolutely loves going to Jetpet and gets SO excited every time we drop him off. The team is so incredibly kind, responsive, and provides lots of pictures and updates while he’s there. We also love being able to watch the 15 minute stream of the dogs playing that they upload to YouTube daily. It is very clear how much love the team at Jetpet has for all of the animals and we are so glad to know Bruno is so well taken care of when we are away. Thank you so much, we are so grateful!!

I had my cat stay here for a week while I was in the process of moving and the staff was great! They were able to accommodate his dietary restrictions and they provide daily pictures + videos of their playtime on Youtube which is comforting. He was happy and well adjusted when he came home as well. Many thanks to the staff :)

Our girl, Sheryl, had her first day at Jet Pet today. She was super happy with her new friends and adjusted right away to her new daycare. The staff were lovely and gave Sheryl lots of affection. I was able to see pictures and videos of her day on Instagram. It was a great experience for our baby. I highly recommend to all dog parents :)

I dropped my pup Willa off for a trial, and she had a good time! She was super tired when she got home (mission accomplished!) The staff is lovely! Attentive and responsive. They're open on weekends, and her regular daycare isn't, so this will be my go-to spot when Willa is needing some playtime with friends on weekends!

We just moved into Vancouver and are looking for a place to get our old girl into a social group. They made a fair assessment of our dog Gracie who is a 10 year old Retriever that is not patient with some of the younger dogs. She offered solutions to make her feel more comfortable.  We will be back for some doggy daycare soon.

Our Boxer Woodford has been visiting Jet Pet Olympic Village once a week for about 3 years now.  He hasn't complained so we are quite happy that he's happy. Everyone is always so nice and happy to see him. I have complete confidence in the staff and don't stress about leaving him there for the day. It's not a large and overwhelming facility for him and there is a good mix of small and big dogs. Nothing really negative to report. I would recommend JPOV

Our dog Stanley has been visiting Jet Pet OV for over 7 years and he is absolutely obsessed with it! The staff have always been so kind and caring towards him which gives us so much peace of mind as he is a rescue. We couldn’t recommend Jet Pet OV more! Thank you for taking the best care of Stanley! 💗 …

I’ve used JetPet for daycare and boarding and I will keep coming back! The people who work there are so kind and loving with the pets under their care. My very anxious and needy GSP is always excited when I drop her off and I never worry about her while she is there.

I'm grateful to have Jet Pet Resort as a Cat Boarding resource for my frequent out-of-town excursions this year, 2026. My 7 y o '50% feral' (.. by my and family's estimations) female tortoiseshell feline seems quite happy with her visits there. Her litter-box behaviour is a kind-of 'tell-all' !! (i.e. no explosions to clean up!). Thank you Jet Pet Resort .. and let's not forget Gabbie, Kim, Moumita, Julia, Jack and others who help make your business so relaible. I hope I get to meet the business owners one day!

This was the first time I boarded my two cats at JetPet. While the majority of space and activity involved dogs, the area for cats was quiet, clean, and staff couldn’t have been more friendly and informative. All my questions were answered and they had plenty of of relevant questions as well. While I was away, I received daily photos of my cats. I was extremely satisfied with the care and attention they received.

Knowledgeable and friendly staff, fair prices and my lab came out happy and excited after his first day. Can't ask for more! First assessment is free as well so I would definitely recommend giving it a try if you're thinking about it.

My dog Indy is pretty socially awkward and introverted and he loves it here!!! The staff are all awesome, I have never had a problem. They are super responsive and always give prompt updates as someone who gets stressed about leaving my pet with someone else. They obviously know what they are doing. Indy always come back sleepy and happy and freshly bathed. Great for daycare and longer stays. Below are some pictures of him during his time there. 🙂🐾
Styne had a great visit yesterday while we took the family to the Vancouver Aquarium! Staff was very nice and pleasant to deal with! We will be coming back!
